# GroupSynchronization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Synchronization of dynamical units that emerges from group-wise coupling (e.g., hyperedges), where entire subsets of nodes lock into coherent activity patterns. Offers a mechanism for coordinated spike-timing in neuromorphic circuits, potentially improving energy efficiency and parallel processing in iNEST hardware.
